card.name: Small words before intensity nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, with, of, by, the) right before a word of degree or intensity such as poverty, caution, great honour or fear. The pole predicts an intensifier like deep or extreme next.

modes.label: Living in poverty
modes.description: The word in after live or living, just before poverty or hardship.
modes.example: 1.4 billion people live<< in>> poverty, based on a new poverty line

modes.label: Used with caution
modes.description: The word with after administered or used, just before caution.
modes.example: Nadolol should be administered<< with>> caution since it may block bronchodilation

modes.label: Other degree phrases
modes.description: Linking words before an emotional or weighty noun such as honour or fear.
modes.example: Social Anxiety Disorder is a common anxiety disorder characterized<< by>> fear and avoidance of various social situations.

card.writes: It pushes the output toward intensity words like deep, profound and extreme.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a strong-degree word, like the with in used with caution or the in in living in poverty.
